name: Impossible Architecture
desc: A slowly turning axonometric lattice of cuboid bar-frames that cannot exist — each frame's farthest strut is repainted over the strut it just passed behind, so the occlusion runs in a cycle and the structure reads as solid and as a lie at once, with stair treads climbing runs that reset where you cannot see.

energy.doc: face luminance, neon bloom and drift amplitude

scale.doc: size of the lattice on the frame (2.2 = struts crash off every edge)

density.doc: how many cuboid frames make up the lattice (3 to 7)

speed.doc: azimuth turn rate; a slow warp keeps it moving even at 0.1

hue.doc: material hue; the void takes its complement

paradox.doc: fraction of frames that tell the lie — 0 is an honest lattice of ordinary cubes, 1 makes every frame impossible

style.doc: aesthetic: modelled solid concrete / hatched paper plate in Escher's own medium / cyan schematic linework / glowing struts on black / form from light alone

seed.doc: frame sizes, positions, strut girth, which frames lie and where the stairs run
